main_text.p: תעב Niph. נתעב Abominabile visum fuit, 1.Paralip.21.6. Part. נתעב Abominabilis, Jes.14.19. Pih. תעב Abominatus est: Abominandum reddidit: Præt. ותעבוני Et abominabuntur me, Job.9.31. Participip. למתעב גוי Et quem abominatur gens, Jesa.49.7. Infin. cum Futur. ותעב תתעבנו Abominando abominator eam, Deut.7.26. Hiph.Præter. התעיבו עלילה Abominandum perpetrant actionem, Psalm.53.2.

תועבה f. Abominatio, Gen.43.32. Constr. תועבת, Gen.46.v.34. Plur. תועבות Abominationes, Lev.18.26. Constr. כתועבות הגוים Secundum abominationes gentium, 2.Reg.16.v.3. Aff. תועבתם Abominationes eorum, Deut.20.18.

תעה Errare, Vagari: Convenit cum טעה. Præter. תעיתי לבבי Errat animus meus, Jesa.21.v.4. לא תעיתי Non erravi, Psalm.119.110. Participip. תועה בשדה Errabat per agrum, Genes.37.15. Plural. Constr. תועי לבב Errantes corde, Psalm.95.10. Futur. per Apocopam, אל־תעה Ne aberrato, Prov.7.25. Niph.Præter. נתעה Errare factus, Seductus est, Job.15.31. Infinit. כהתעות Sicut oberrat, Jes.19.14. Pih. geminatis duabus literis. Particip. כמתעתע Sicut errare faciens, Seductor, Gen.27.12. Hiph. התעה Errare fecit, In errorem induxit, Seduxit. Præterit. התעו Seduxit, Hos.4.12. התעו אתי Quum errare facerent me, Gen.20.13. Particip. מתעה Errare facit, Prov.10.17. Plural. מתעים Seductores, Jes.19.16. Hithp.Partic.Plur. ומתעתעים Et seducebantur, 2.Par.36.16.
תעיתים m. p. Errores, Seductiones graves, Jerem.10.v.15.

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (Psalm, Jes., Genes., Nehem.). The catchword at the lower right is partly unclear and marked [?]. Hebrew vowel points are transcribed as far as they can be read at this scan size; a few points may be lost. Headwords are set in larger Hebrew type but are run into the entries, so they are kept as paragraphs rather than headings.
